mapper.insert: INSERT INTO violation_work_order (alert_id,risk_level,latitude,longitude,position_sampled_at,created_at) SELECT a.id, CASE WHEN a.behavior_code IN ('c1','c2','c3','c4') THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'GENERAL' END, t.latitude,t.longitude,t.sampled_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) + INTERVAL 8 HOUR FROM alert_record a LEFT JOIN vehicle_telemetry t ON t.vehicle_id=a.vehicle_id AND t.driver_id=a.driver_id AND t.sampled_at=( SELECT MAX(p.sampled_at) FROM vehicle_telemetry p WHERE p.vehicle_id=a.vehicle_id AND p.driver_id=a.driver_id AND p.sampled_at BETWEEN (TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,'1970-01-01 08:00:00',a.captured_at) DIV 1000)-15000 AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,'1970-01-01 08:00:00',a.captured_at) DIV 1000 ) WHERE a.record_type IN ('SMS_ALERT','BACKLOG') AND a.status IN ('OPEN','CONFIRMED') AND a.id=#{alertId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE alert_id=violation_work_order.alert_id
mapper.update: UPDATE violation_work_order SET status='CANCELED' WHERE alert_id=#{alertId} AND status IN ('PENDING','ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS')
mapper.select: SELECT alert_id FROM violation_work_order WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT w.id, CONCAT('WO-',w.id) AS order_no,w.alert_id,a.driver_id,a.vehicle_id,a.fleet_id,a.captured_at, a.record_type,a.behavior_code,a.max_p AS confidence,a.status AS alert_status,w.risk_level,w.status,w.latitude, w.longitude,w.position_sampled_at,w.assignee_id,w.assigned_at,w.started_at,w.closed_at,w.closed_by,w.outcome, w.resolution,w.recommendation_action,w.recommendation_note,w.recommendation_by,w.recommendation_at,w.created_at FROM violation_work_order w JOIN alert_record a ON a.id=w.alert_id
mapper.select: SELECT u.id,u.name,p.latitude,p.longitude,p.reported_at,COALESCE(w.active_orders,0) FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN dispatch_operator_location p ON p.user_id=u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT assignee_id,COUNT(*) AS active_orders FROM violation_work_order WHERE status IN ('ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS') GROUP BY assignee_id ) w ON w.assignee_id=u.id WHERE u.role='PLATFORM_ADMIN' AND u.enabled=1 ORDER BY u.id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{id} AND role='PLATFORM_ADMIN' AND enabled=1)
mapper.update: UPDATE violation_work_order SET status='ASSIGNED',assignee_id=#{assigneeId},assigned_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE violation_work_order SET status='IN_PROGRESS',started_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ASSIGNED'
